clue.text: Better cold drink container put back in front of office for coffee

parts.note: to better someone is to cap them, outdoing them

indicators.note: put back means the container word is turned round and read from its end

parts.note: a cup holds a drink
C is the abbreviation for cold, as on a tap
taken as written

indicators.note: the front of a word is its opening letter, taken from office

explanation.surface: Instructions for making an office coffee: put the cold cup back in front of the office.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Better' looks like an adjective but is the verb to cap. 'put back' reverses the drink container, and 'front of office' is its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: A cappuccino is a type of espresso coffee topped with frothed milk.

clue.text: Weapon found in island hospital

parts.note: Cos (Kos) is a Greek island in the Dodecanese
H is the abbreviation for hospital, as on road signs

explanation.surface: A weapon turns up in a hospital on an island.
explanation.definitionFit: A cosh is a short heavy club or bludgeon, a British word for a blackjack.

clue.text: VIP raves possibly about end of surveillance that's widespread

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the shuffled letters go round the extra letter
possibly signals that the letters of VIP raves can be rearranged in some other way
the end of a word is its final letter, taken here from surveillance

explanation.surface: A celebrity is raving about surveillance that has become widespread.
explanation.walkthrough: 'possibly' rearranges VIPRAVES to PERVASIV, and 'about' wraps those letters round E, the 'end of surveillance'.
explanation.definitionFit: Pervasive means spreading through everything, so widespread is a direct synonym.

clue.text: Pontiff averse to the countryside?

definitions.meaning: a pope; there were several popes named ...
jokingly, someone or something of the city rather than the country

explanation.definitionFit: Urban is the name of eight popes, and as an adjective it means belonging to towns and cities.

clue.text: Musical exposed to view during another almost

indicators.note: during means that one piece of the clue occurs within the span of the other
almost means the last letter of the show title is lopped off

parts.note: another musical, namely Cats, Andrew Lloyd Webber's show
bare means uncovered and on show

explanation.surface: A musical in which performers are exposed to view during another show, almost.
explanation.walkthrough: 'another' means another musical: Lloyd Webber's show, which 'almost' cuts short, and 'during' puts the word for exposed inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Cabaret is the Kander and Ebb stage musical set in a 1930s Berlin nightclub.

clue.text: Greek character bungled clues? That's the heart of the matter

definitions.text: That's the heart of the matter

parts.note: nu is the thirteenth letter of the Greek alphabet

indicators.note: bungled means messed up, so the letters of clues are put in a new order

explanation.surface: Someone frets that bungled crossword clues are at the heart of the matter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bungled' says the letters of clues are rearranged; they follow the Greek letter, and the whole question is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A nucleus is the central core around which something is built, literally its heart.

clue.text: Uncle, say, holding cape in trick

indicators.note: holding means one word clasps another letter within it

parts.note: Uncle Sam, the personification of the USA; 'say' marks Uncle as an example needing a name
C is the map abbreviation for cape

explanation.surface: An uncle holds onto a cape as part of some trick.
explanation.definitionFit: A scam is a dishonest scheme or swindle, so a trick played on the gullible.

clue.text: Supply college over a short academic period

indicators.note: in a down clue, over means the first piece sits above the next
short means the word loses its last letter

parts.note: a term is a division of the school or university year

explanation.surface: A college keeps supplies going for most of an academic term.
explanation.walkthrough: 'short' trims TERM to TER.
explanation.definitionFit: To cater is to provide food and drink, so to supply what is needed.

clue.text: Puppet manipulated one time with art

indicators.note: manipulated means handled and moved about, as a puppeteer moves strings, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A puppet is manipulated, one time, with artistry.
explanation.walkthrough: 'manipulated' rearranges ONE TIME and ART; 'with' just joins the two parts of the fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: A marionette is a puppet worked from above by strings.

clue.text: Get rid of stunted trees

definitions.meaning: to cancel or abandon a plan
low, stunted vegetation and bushes covering rough ground

explanation.definitionFit: To scrub a plan is to cancel it, and scrub is also land covered by low bushes.

clue.text: Second person offering service I avoided in isolated area

parts.note: to second a proposal is to back it

indicators.note: avoided means this letter is kept out of the word

parts.note: a waiter serves customers at table
taken as written

explanation.surface: A second waiter offers service in a remote spot, but I am avoided.
explanation.walkthrough: 'avoided' takes the I out of WAITER, leaving WATER.
explanation.definitionFit: A backwater is a quiet place cut off from events, like still water off a river's current.

clue.text: Faltering figure in Washington with shift embracing right

parts.note: WA is the postal abbreviation for the US state of Washington

indicators.note: embracing means hugging, so one word wraps round a letter

parts.note: to veer is to shift direction

explanation.surface: A hesitant figure in Washington shifts position to embrace the right wing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'embracing' puts R into VEER to give VERER.
explanation.definitionFit: A waverer is someone who hesitates and cannot make up their mind, a faltering person.

clue.text: Road in front of Northern oak, say, and course

indicators.note: in front of means the first piece comes before the rest

parts.note: the A1 is Britain's major north-south road, written AI in crosswords
an oak is an example of a tree

explanation.surface: Directions: take the road north past an oak and you reach the racecourse.
explanation.walkthrough: The A1 is the UK's longest road, from London to Edinburgh; its 1 stands for the letter I. Aintree, near Liverpool, is the racecourse of the Grand National.
explanation.definitionFit: Aintree is a racecourse, home of the Grand National steeplechase.

clue.text: Noted potter in house

definitions.meaning: John ..., a well-known snooker player and commentator, potted balls for a living
one of the twelve houses or signs of the zodiac

explanation.walkthrough: 'potter' looks like a maker of ceramics; here it is someone who pots snooker balls.
explanation.definitionFit: John Virgo is a famous snooker player, and Virgo is the sixth sign or house of the zodiac.

clue.text: Phrase tome represented gives prevailing mood

indicators.note: represented means presented again in a new form, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A phrase in a weighty tome sets the prevailing mood.
explanation.walkthrough: 'represented' rearranges PHRASE TOME.
explanation.definitionFit: The atmosphere of a place is its pervading tone or mood.

clue.text: Knitter manufactured worthless ornament

explanation.surface: A knitter makes a cheap bauble.
explanation.walkthrough: 'manufactured' rearranges KNITTER.
explanation.definitionFit: A trinket is a small ornament or piece of jewellery of little value.

clue.text: Flier among quickest released

indicators.note: among means the answer lies within the run of letters of the following words

explanation.surface: A bird was among the quickest to be released.
explanation.definitionFit: A kestrel is a small falcon, a bird that flies and hovers.

clue.text: Outward appearance characterising Bondi champion?

definitions.meaning: the outside or superficial look of something
split 4,3, an ace at the surf, as found at Bondi Beach in Sydney

explanation.walkthrough: Bondi Beach in Sydney is famous for surfing; split the answer as SURF ACE.

clue.text: A woman placed on feature near window rising plant

parts.note: taken as written
Mary is a woman's name

indicators.note: in a down clue, rising means the word is read upwards

parts.note: a sill sits at the base of a window

clue.text: Manage at least twelve deliveries before middle of week

indicators.note: before means the first piece comes ahead of the other

parts.note: in cricket an over is six balls, so overs means at least two overs, twelve deliveries

indicators.note: the middle of a word is its central letters, here the inside pair of week

explanation.surface: A manager has to see at least twelve deliveries arrive before midweek.
explanation.walkthrough: 'deliveries' are cricket balls: six make an over. The middle of WEEK is EE.
explanation.definitionFit: To oversee is to supervise, which is to manage people or work.

clue.text: Question one that's dumped a rich source

parts.note: an ex is a former partner, someone who has been dumped
taken as written
a mine is a rich source, as in a mine of information

explanation.surface: Someone questions a dumped partner who was a rich source of money.
explanation.definitionFit: To examine a witness is to question them formally.

clue.text: Fruit's fashionable, we hear

indicators.note: we hear signals that the word sounds like the one wanted when spoken

parts.note: current means in vogue, up to date

explanation.definitionFit: A currant is a small dried grape or a berry of the Ribes bush.

clue.text: Old church in island mostly showing decorative work

indicators.note: in means the first pair of letters is placed inside the shortened island
mostly means all but the last letter of the island is used

parts.note: Crete is the largest Greek island

explanation.walkthrough: 'mostly' drops the island's last letter, and 'in' puts the old church letters inside what remains.
explanation.definitionFit: Crochet is lacy needlework made with a hooked needle, a kind of decorative work.

clue.text: Communication device shown in time amid spin doctor's work?

parts.note: PR, public relations, is what a spin doctor does
an age is a period of time

explanation.definitionFit: A pager is a small radio device that receives messages, a bleeper.

clue.text: Risk with mass leaving upper part of house

parts.note: to gamble is to take a risk

clue.text: Moan manufactured by a discontented lady? An irregular occurrence

indicators.note: manufactured means made up, so the letters of moan are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: discontented means emptied of its contents, leaving only its outer letters

explanation.walkthrough: 'manufactured' rearranges MOAN to ANOM; 'discontented' empties LADY to LY.

clue.text: Horrify a Scandinavian in turn

clue.text: Scottish landowner restricted retreat

clue.text: Elaborate revolutionary writer and inventor is hard to follow

taken as written

clue.text: Old US president taken with a dance

taken as written

clue.text: Some sheep escaped round part of fencing

indicators.note: round means the run of letters is turned the other way
some means only a portion of the letters of the next words is wanted

explanation.surface: Some sheep escaped round part of the fencing.

clue.text: Ground if sterile needing bit of revitalisation — with this?

definitions.text: Ground if sterile needing bit of revitalisation — with this?

indicators.note: needing means the first part requires the next to be added after it
ground means crushed or milled, so the letters are broken up and rearranged
a bit of a word is its opening letter, here from revitalisation

explanation.surface: Barren ground needs revitalising, and this is what it needs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Ground' rearranges IF STERILE into FERTILISE, and 'bit of' gives the R of revitalisation. The whole clue also says what the stuff is for.
explanation.definitionFit: Fertiliser is added to soil to make infertile land productive again.
